intro: Look at the clues, and guess who lives there. Ready?

items.name: Bird
items.clue_text: A cozy nest, high up in a tree
items.reveal_line: Yes! A bird lives in a nest!
items.fact: Birds build nests with twigs and leaves!

items.name: Bee
items.reveal_line: Yes! A bee lives in a hive!
items.fact: Bees go buzz, buzz, from flower to flower!

items.name: Fish
items.clue_text: Big blue waves and colourful coral
items.reveal_line: Yes! A fish lives in the sea!
items.fact: Fish swim, swim, swim all day!

items.name: Dog
items.clue_text: A little house and a yummy bone
items.reveal_line: Yes! A dog lives in a kennel!
items.fact: Dogs love to run and wag their tails!

items.name: Polar Bear
items.clue_text: Cold, cold ice and fluffy snow
items.reveal_line: Yes! A polar bear lives on the snow and ice!
items.fact: Polar bears have thick white fur to stay warm!

items.name: Camel
items.clue_text: Lots of sand and a hot, hot sun
items.reveal_line: Yes! A camel lives in the desert!
items.fact: Camels can walk a long, long way!

items.name: Frog
items.clue_text: A floating flower and lots of water
items.reveal_line: Yes! A frog lives in a pond!

items.name: Monkey
items.clue_text: Tall green trees and yummy bananas
items.reveal_line: Yes! A monkey lives in the jungle!
items.fact: Monkeys love to swing from tree to tree!

seo.title: Who Lives Here? 🏠🐝 Animal Homes for Kids | Guessing Game for Kids | Unique Kiddo
seo.description:
Who lives in a nest? Who lives in a hive? 🤔 Play the animal homes guessing game with Kiddo! Look at the two clues, think, and shout out the animal!

A fun learning video for kids about animals and where they live. Children learn 8 animals and their homes:
🐦 Bird – nest
🐝 Bee – hive
🐠 Fish – sea
🐕 Dog – kennel
🐻‍❄️ Polar Bear – snow and ice
🐫 Camel – desert
🐸 Frog – pond
🐒 Monkey – jungle

Each round has think time so kids can guess, and a "say it with me" pause to practise new English words. Great for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2–6).

⭐ Subscribe to Unique Kiddo for more fun learning games: colours, numbers, fruits, vehicles and more!

Voice: Kokoro TTS (Apache 2.0) · Emoji art: Noto Emoji (Apache 2.0)
